ekalakkhaṇa.p: [ eka + lakkhaṇa ] (na) Google Translate (1) One mark. (Ii) (2) having only one-sense-characteristic; (3) They have the same characteristics.

CPD: eka-lakkhaṇa , mfn. , sharing a single ( one and the same ) characteristic ( said of dhamma s ); vuttamhi eka- dhamme ye dhammā ~ ā keci, Peṭ 90, 16* qu. Paṭis-a 513, 28* ; te dhammā ~ h upādānalakkhaṇena, Peṭ 91, 10 ; ye ~ ā dhammā, tesaṃ ekamhi dhamme niddiṭṭhe sabbe dhammā niddiṭṭhā honti, 91, 13 ; ye keci cittena channe- na ~ ā dhammā, 204, 15 ; 204, 17 ; ye dhammā ~ ā, tesaṃ dhammānaṃ ekasmiṃ dhamme vutte avasiṭṭhā dhamma vuttā bhavanti, Nett 30, 5 ≠ 32, 23 ; sabbāni hi cha aj- jhattikāni āyatanāni vadhak'-atthena ~ āni, 30, 16 ; sabbe hi pañcakkhandhā Yamakovāda-sutte vadhak'-atthena ~ ā vuttā, 30, 25 ; sabbe hi bodhaṅgamā dhammā bodhi- pakkhiyā niyyānika-lakkhaṇena ~ ā, 31, 23 = 83, 15 ; taṃ hi kumbhijajjarakaraṇena ca mātikā-ujukaraṇena ca saddhiṃ ~ ā, Sp 321, 20 ; ayoniso-manasikāro sabbattha ~ o va, Ps l 282, 20 ≠ lt-a ll 179, 12 ; etth' eva ca vodā- natthapaṭivedhassa vuttattā tena ~ ā, Paṭis-a 513, 24 ; evaṃ appamāṇagocaratāya ~ āsu ( Be so ; Ee w. r. ettha lakkhaṇāsu) câpi etāsu purimā tisso tikacatukkajjhārikā va honti, As 196, 30 .

eka-lakkhaṇa-tta , n., abs. tr. of prec. state of shar- ing a single ( one and the same ) characteristic ( "single- ness of characteristic", Ñm ); ~ ā catunnaṃ indriyānaṃ, Nett 31, 9 = 83, 7 ; te ~ ā bhāvanāpāripūriṃ gacchanti, 31, 24 = 83, 16 ; evaṃ akusalā pi dhammā ~ ā pahānaṃ abbhatthaṃ gacchanti, 31, 25 = 32, 1 ; Sv-pṭ Be l 252, 8 — 253, 2 .
